onChange.script:
system.perspective.print('change origin is %s'%origin)
	
	if origin != 'BindingWriteback': return

	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	settings = self.custom.main
	
	for k,v in settings.items():
		configInfo = {'configTypeName': 'color', 'configName': k, 'configValue': v}
		system.kanoa.config.saveConfig(configInfo, userId)
		
	theme = self.session.props.theme
	if theme == 'kanoa-light': 
		self.session.props.theme = 'kanoa-dark'
		import time
		time.sleep(0.2)
		self.session.props.theme = 'kanoa-light'
	else:
		self.session.props.theme = 'kanoa-light'
		import time
		time.sleep(0.2)
		self.session.props.theme = 'kanoa-dark'
		
	return
